These four clues should be physically integrated in perspective, not floating graphic labels. No implication his held Bitcoin was liquidated. His main monitor can show a restrained crashing red chart with tiny 'STILL HODLING' note; no extra prose.
Raw artwork only, no frame, no title bar, no card branding, no QR, no border. Keep top corners comparatively quiet and bottom 20% to expendable shadowed floor/debris, no essential hands, face, text or mug in overlay zones. Premium mature drawn anime/manhwa finish matching all four supplied originals across entire scene, clean varied line weight, two-to-three-tone shadows, local color and selective highlights. No photorealism, no glossy 3D, no airbrushed face, no excessive grunge, no extra fingers or limbs, no gore.
